integrity: The proof reconstructs the relevant weighted BMO and VMO quotient directly. Necessity is witnessed by two explicit scaling families of Carleson boxes, and sufficiency follows from derivative control on far boxes plus direct decay integration on boxes comparable to their distance from the pole. The operator conclusion then uses the cited analytic-symbol boundedness and compactness characterizations.
scientific_limitations: The classification is for upper-half-plane power weights and a holomorphic Cauchy-pole symbol with the pole strictly below the boundary. It does not cover boundary poles, nonanalytic symbols, general regularly varying weights, or interactions among several singularities.
title: Sharp power-weight phase diagram for Cauchy-pole Bergman commutators
